Desc: Bouncy objects have more knockback and give extra score based on the velocity of the colliding ball(s).

Charge is a resource that stacks. A ball holding Charge has a 50% chance on each collision to activate that many of the nearest components. Components that require Charge take it from the ball on contact instead, and spend it when they have enough.
A detonation activates every component in its radius. The detonating object is not destroyed.
Frozen objects shatter when they collide, doubling the scoring of that collision and applying increased knockback. They then lose the Frozen effect.
Kinetic objects scale their scoring on the square of the ball's speed, from 0.25x when barely moving up to 8x on a hard hit.
Any object that has "X in Y" chances has Odds. Increasing odds means lowering Y by that amount.

When a ball or component is On Fire, it activates as if collided with 1-4 times per second for 4 seconds, and its scoring increases by 25% each activation. Lighting something that is already On Fire refreshes the duration and keeps the increased scoring.
